reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through the tree's existing linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank; but the download and the takeover's reset are rewritten rather than reused from the Akahu download and unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, the new fintegra starting-balance branch copies the akahu branch, releaseExistingLink copies unlinkAccount's field reset, and the releaseExistingLink call is repeated in both upgrade/new branches.

placement.why: Guards sit in accounts/app.ts with the link handlers and the download in sync.ts as in the tree; the guard is called separately in each of six provider functions instead of once in the shared linkBankSyncAccount they all use.

scope.why: Edits serve the four steps; client edits are only the required provider Record entries.

maintainability.why: The replace flag is split across an assert that skips on it and a release inside linkBankSyncAccount, and three copied blocks must be kept in sync with their originals.

bypasses_abstraction.where: releaseExistingLink in accounts/app.ts resets the account's bank fields itself instead of reusing unlinkAccount's reset; the guard is invoked per provider outside the shared linkBankSyncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (Fintegra download, fintegra balance branch, unlink reset) are open near-verbatim copies.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gained replaceExistingLink (passed to releaseExistingLink in both branches); assertBankAccountNotLinked takes replaceExistingLink and holds a closed-account branch; all six provider functions call the assert.
